headline: Claude's expanded capabilities spark debate over AI safety and clinical deployment
body: Anthropic's Claude continues gaining traction across developer communities with new features including auto mode for Claude Code and expanded agent capabilities through generative UI frameworks. The velocity and breadth of Claude adoption raise critical questions for healthcare AI implementation, particularly around consent interpretation, safety classifiers, and autonomous decision-making in clinical workflows. Healthcare organizations considering Claude integration need concrete answers on how the model handles sensitive patient data, validates clinical reasoning, and maintains audit trails required for compliance. These safety and interpretability concerns directly impact vendor selection for EHR augmentation and clinical decision support tools that operate in regulated environments.
